newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Burma launches new air service to Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Burma launches new air service to Indonesia.

text.p: Myanmar Airways International (MAI) has become the first Burmese operator to operate to Indonesia, the airline said in a statement on Wednesday.
The statement said the airline's inaugural service on the route began on Tuesday when a Boeing 737-400 arrived in Jakarta from the Burmese capital Rangoon after flying via Singapore.
The Jakarta Post newspaper reported on Wednesday that MAI planned to operate two services a week between Rangoon and Jakarta.
It said state-owned Myanmar Airways had a 51 percent stake in MAI, set up in 1993, with Highsonic Enterprises of Singapore holding the remaining stake in the venture.
The paper quoted officials as saying the service would target both business travellers and tourists.
Burma, also known as Myanmar, last month launched Visit Myanmar Year in an effort to attract more than 500,000 visitors a year.
The statement said MAI also flies to Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Dhaka and Kunming in China.
